# Bundled libraries

- `plotly.min.js`: Plotly.js 4.1.1, copied from the project's installed Plotly 7.1.0 Python package. MIT license; see `PLOTLY-LICENSE.txt`. Upstream: https://github.com/plotly/plotly.js
- `source-sans.woff2`: unchanged Source Sans variable upright font distributed with the project's installed Streamlit 1.64.0. Copyright Adobe. SIL Open Font License 1.1. Upstream font and license: https://github.com/adobe-fonts/source-sans/blob/release/LICENSE.md

These files are bundled locally so rendering does not depend on a third-party CDN.
